import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches
import os
import shutil

WORKSPACE_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK"
DOWNLOADS_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads"
ARTIFACT_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c"

BG_COLOR = "#33363b"       # Matches GTAVI_MISSION_FLOW1.jpg dark-slate gray

def draw_mission(ax, x, y, w, h, title, subtitle="", is_climax=False, is_gate=False, font_size=8.5):
    bg = "#fef08a" if not is_climax else "#ffedd5"
    border = "#ca8a04" if not is_climax else "#ea580c"
    lw = 2.0 if (is_climax or is_gate) else 1.2
    
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=lw, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    ty = y + h/2 + 0.12 if subtitle else y + h/2
    ax.text(x + w/2, ty, title, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#1c1917", zorder=4)
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + 0.18, subtitle, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size-1.8, color="#44403c", zorder=4)

def draw_callout(ax, x, y, w, h, text, icon_type="text", font_size=7.2):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.0, edgecolor="#71717a", facecolor="#ffffff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    prefix = ""
    if icon_type == "phone":
        prefix = "[CALL] "
    elif icon_type == "text":
        prefix = "[MSG] "
    elif icon_type == "mailbox":
        prefix = "[MAILBOX] "
    elif icon_type == "cash":
        prefix = "[$] "
        
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, prefix + text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold" if icon_type=="phone" else "normal", color="#09090b", zorder=4)

def draw_heart(ax, x, y, w, h, text, skip_label="[ANY% SKIP]", font_size=7.0):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.2, edgecolor="#f43f5e", facecolor="#ffe4e6", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    t = "♥ " + text
    if skip_label:
        t += "\n" + skip_label
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, t, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#9f1239", zorder=4)

def draw_side(ax, x, y, w, h, text, font_size=7.0):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.2, edgecolor="#a855f7", facecolor="#f3e8ff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    t = text + "\n[OPTIONAL / SKIP]"
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, t, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, color="#581c87", zorder=4)

def draw_diamond(ax, cx, cy, rx, ry, text, font_size=6.8):
    pts = [[cx, cy + ry], [cx + rx, cy], [cx, cy - ry], [cx - rx, cy]]
    poly = patches.Polygon(pts, closed=True, linewidth=1.4, edgecolor="#cbd5e1", facecolor="#ffffff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#0f172a", zorder=4)

def draw_speedrun_badge(ax, x, y, w, h, title, note, font_size=6.8):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.4, edgecolor="#10b981", facecolor="#064e3b", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h - 0.22, "⚡ " + title, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size+0.6, fontweight="bold", color="#34d399", zorder=4)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2 - 0.1, note, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, color="#ecfdf5", zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, p1, p2, color="#ffffff", lw=1.2, rad=0.0):
    conn = f"arc3,rad={rad}" if rad != 0 else "arc3,rad=0"
    ax.annotate(
        "",
        xy=p2, xytext=p1,
        arrowprops=dict(
            arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.28,head_length=0.38",
            color=color,
            lw=lw,
            shrinkA=3,
            shrinkB=3,
            connectionstyle=conn
        ),
        zorder=2
    )

# =========================================================================
# 1. RENDER EXACT CHAPTER 1 MATCHING image_1188e9.jpg GROUND TRUTH + SPEEDRUN
# =========================================================================
def render_speedrun_chapter_1():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(24, 28), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 28)
    ax.axis("off")
    
    # Title Banner
    ax.text(12, 27.4, "GRAND THEFT AUTO VI — CHAPTER 1 MISSION FLOW (GROUND TRUTH)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color="#ffffff")
    ax.text(12, 26.9, "Exact 3-Branch Parallel Structure, Decision Diamonds, Mailboxes & Corrected Mission Flow (Missions 1 - 18)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color="#fde047")
    
    # Top: PROLOGUE -> GONE FISHING
    mw, mh = 3.6, 0.95
    center_x = 10.2
    
    draw_mission(ax, center_x, 25.5, mw, mh, "PROLOGUE", "Lucia Prison Counselor Interview")
    draw_mission(ax, center_x, 24.0, mw, mh, "GONE FISHING", "Jason & Donnie Boat Drop")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches
import os
import shutil

WORKSPACE_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK"
DOWNLOADS_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads"
ARTIFACT_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c"

BG_COLOR = "#33363b"       # Matches GTAVI_MISSION_FLOW1.jpg dark-slate gray

def draw_mission(ax, x, y, w, h, title, subtitle="", is_climax=False, is_gate=False, font_size=8.5):
    bg = "#fef08a" if not is_climax else "#ffedd5"
    border = "#ca8a04" if not is_climax else "#ea580c"
    lw = 2.0 if (is_climax or is_gate) else 1.2
    
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=lw, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    ty = y + h/2 + 0.12 if subtitle else y + h/2
    ax.text(x + w/2, ty, title, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#1c1917", zorder=4)
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + 0.18, subtitle, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size-1.8, color="#44403c", zorder=4)

def draw_callout(ax, x, y, w, h, text, icon_type="text", font_size=7.2):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.0, edgecolor="#71717a", facecolor="#ffffff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    prefix = ""
    if icon_type == "phone":
        prefix = "[CALL] "
    elif icon_type == "text":
        prefix = "[MSG] "
    elif icon_type == "mailbox":
        prefix = "[MAILBOX] "
    elif icon_type == "cash":
        prefix = "[$] "
        
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, prefix + text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold" if icon_type=="phone" else "normal", color="#09090b", zorder=4)

def draw_heart(ax, x, y, w, h, text, skip_label="[ANY% SKIP]", font_size=7.0):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.2, edgecolor="#f43f5e", facecolor="#ffe4e6", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    t = "♥ " + text
    if skip_label:
        t += "\n" + skip_label
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, t, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#9f1239", zorder=4)

def draw_side(ax, x, y, w, h, text, font_size=7.0):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.2, edgecolor="#a855f7", facecolor="#f3e8ff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    t = text + "\n[OPTIONAL / SKIP]"
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, t, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, color="#581c87", zorder=4)

def draw_diamond(ax, cx, cy, rx, ry, text, font_size=6.8):
    pts = [[cx, cy + ry], [cx + rx, cy], [cx, cy - ry], [cx - rx, cy]]
    poly = patches.Polygon(pts, closed=True, linewidth=1.4, edgecolor="#cbd5e1", facecolor="#ffffff", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, fontweight="bold", color="#0f172a", zorder=4)

def draw_speedrun_badge(ax, x, y, w, h, title, note, font_size=6.8):
    rect = patches.Rectangle((x, y), w, h, linewidth=1.4, edgecolor="#10b981", facecolor="#064e3b", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h - 0.22, "⚡ " + title, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size+0.6, fontweight="bold", color="#34d399", zorder=4)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2 - 0.1, note, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size, color="#ecfdf5", zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, p1, p2, color="#ffffff", lw=1.2, rad=0.0):
    conn = f"arc3,rad={rad}" if rad != 0 else "arc3,rad=0"
    ax.annotate(
        "",
        xy=p2, xytext=p1,
        arrowprops=dict(
            arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.28,head_length=0.38",
            color=color,
            lw=lw,
            shrinkA=3,
            shrinkB=3,
            connectionstyle=conn
        ),
        zorder=2
    )

# =========================================================================
# 1. RENDER EXACT CHAPTER 1 MATCHING image_1188e9.jpg GROUND TRUTH + SPEEDRUN
# =========================================================================
def render_speedrun_chapter_1():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(25, 28), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 25)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 28)
    ax.axis("off")
    
    # Title Banner
    ax.text(12.5, 27.4, "GRAND THEFT AUTO VI — CHAPTER 1 MISSION FLOW (GROUND TRUTH)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color="#ffffff")
    ax.text(12.5, 26.9, "Exact 3-Branch Parallel Structure, Decision Diamonds, Mailboxes & Corrected Mission Flow (Missions 1 - 18)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color="#fde047")
    
    # Top: PROLOGUE -> GONE FISHING

    draw_mission(ax, center_x, 25.5, mw, mh, "PROLOGUE", "Lucia Prison Counselor Interview")
    draw_mission(ax, center_x, 24.0, mw, mh, "GONE FISHING", "Jason & Donnie Boat Drop")
    draw_arrow(ax, (center_x + mw/2, 25.5), (center_x + mw/2, 24.95))
    
    # Donnie Text Mailbox
    draw_callout(ax, center_x + mw + 0.4, 24.05, 3.4, 0.75, "DONNIE TEXT\n($140 IN MAILBOX)", "mailbox")
    draw_arrow(ax, (center_x + mw, 24.45), (center_x + mw + 0.4, 24.45))
    
    # Split bar below Gone Fishing (splits into 3 parallel tracks)
    split_y = 23.2
    ax.plot([2.2, 5.7, 12.6], [split_y, split_y, split_y], color="#ffffff", lw=1.5, zorder=2)
    draw_arrow(ax, (center_x + mw/2, 24.0), (center_x + mw/2, split_y))
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # BRANCH 1: UNWANTED ATTENTION & PIPEWORK (Left Track: x = 0.7)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    b1_x = 0.7
    mw1 = 3.0
    draw_arrow(ax, (2.2, split_y), (b1_x + mw1/2, 22.2))
    draw_mission(ax, b1_x, 21.2, mw1, mh, "UNWANTED ATTENTION", "Cal & Jason Drive to Hamlet")
    
    draw_callout(ax, b1_x, 20.1, mw1, 0.75, "CAL TEXT\n($200 IN MAILBOX)", "mailbox")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 21.2), (b1_x + mw1/2, 20.85))
    
    draw_callout(ax, b1_x, 19.0, mw1, 0.65, "BRIAN CALL", "phone")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 20.1), (b1_x + mw1/2, 19.65))
    
    draw_mission(ax, b1_x, 17.7, mw1, mh, "PIPEWORK", "Marina Maintenance Jobs")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 19.0), (b1_x + mw1/2, 18.65))
    
    draw_callout(ax, b1_x, 16.6, mw1, 0.65, "BRIAN TEXT", "text")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 17.7), (b1_x + mw1/2, 17.25))
    
    # Chuck Gun shop text offshoot (placed directly in Branch 1 below Brian text)
    draw_callout(ax, b1_x, 15.4, mw1, 0.75, "CHUCK'S GUN SHOP TEXT\n(Cooldown / After Pipework)", "text", font_size=6.2)
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 16.6), (b1_x + mw1/2, 16.15))
    
    # Speedrun routing tip for Branch 1
    draw_speedrun_badge(ax, b1_x - 0.2, 13.3, mw1 + 0.4, 1.7, "DOWNTIME PARALLEL ROUTING", "Clear Unwanted Attention & Pipework\nduring Feng Shui's 24h wait!\nGrab $200 mailbox immediately.")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b1_x + mw1/2, 15.4), (b1_x + mw1/2, 15.0))
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # BRANCH 2: GEAR UP & JUST A SCRATCH (Middle-Left Track: x = 4.2)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    b2_x = 4.2
    mw2 = 3.0
    draw_arrow(ax, (5.7, split_y), (b2_x + mw2/2, 22.2))
    draw_mission(ax, b2_x, 21.2, mw2, mh, "GEAR UP", "Pick up Longarm for Brian")
    
    draw_callout(ax, b2_x, 20.0, mw2, 0.75, "POST-MISSION FORCED CALL\nFROM DONNIE", "phone")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b2_x + mw2/2, 21.2), (b2_x + mw2/2, 20.75))
    
    draw_callout(ax, b2_x, 18.9, mw2, 0.65, "JOEY TEXT", "text")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b2_x + mw2/2, 20.0), (b2_x + mw2/2, 19.55))
    
    draw_heart(ax, b2_x, 17.6, mw2, mh, "JUST A SCRATCH\n(Ganado Repair & Respray)", skip_label="[MANDATORY STORY GATE!]")
    draw_arrow(ax, (b2_x + mw2/2, 18.9), (b2_x + mw2/2, 18.55))
    
    scratch_line_x = b2_x + mw2/2   # x = 5.7
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # SUB-BRANCH: ISLAND DREAMS (Keys Diving: x = 7.6)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    isl_x = 7.6
    isl_w = 2.8
    draw_mission(ax, isl_x, 18.7, isl_w, mh, "ISLAND DREAMS", "Keys Diving")
    draw_callout(ax, isl_x, 17.5, isl_w, 0.75, "KENTON CALL\n(Treasure Search)", "phone")
    draw_arrow(ax, (isl_x + isl_w/2, 18.7), (isl_x + isl_w/2, 18.25))
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # BRANCH 3: LAB FEES -> HEY ARNOLD! -> FENG SHUI -> COMING HOME (x = 10.8)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    b3_x = 10.8
    mw3 = 3.6
    draw_arrow(ax, (12.6, split_y), (b3_x + mw3/2, 22.2))
    draw_mission(ax, b3_x, 21.2, mw3, mh, "LAB FEES", "Brian's Rent Collection")

    draw_arrow(ax, (b3_x + mw3, 21.65), (b3_x + mw3 + 0.4, 21.65))
    
    draw_callout(ax, b3_x, 20.0, mw3, 0.65, "BRIAN'S CALL", "phone")

    draw_arrow(ax, (b3_x + 6.2, 19.1), (b3_x + 6.5, 19.1))
    
    draw_side(ax, b3_x + 9.6, 18.7, 2.8, 0.85, "DONNIE TEXT\nKingfishers Robbery")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches

TEXT_COLOR = "#f8fafc"
SUBTEXT_COLOR = "#94a3b8"

STYLES = {
    "normal": {
        "bg": "#161d2b",
        "border": "#00d4ff",
        "title": "#38bdf8",
        "badge_bg": "#083344",
        "badge_fg": "#38bdf8"
    },
    "milestone": {
        "bg": "#231528",

    },
    "point_of_no_return": {

        "border": "#10b981",
        "title": "#34d399",
        "badge_bg": "#064e3b",
        "badge_fg": "#34d399"
    }
}

def draw_card(ax, x, y, w, h, title, subtitle="", badge="", card_type="normal", fontsize=9):
    st = STYLES.get(card_type, STYLES["normal"])
    
    rect = patches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x, y), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.03,rounding_size=0.15",
        linewidth=1.6,
        edgecolor=st["border"],
        facecolor=st["bg"],
        zorder=3
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    if badge:
        ax.text(
            x + w/2, y + h - 0.16,
            badge.upper(),
            ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=fontsize - 2.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=st["badge_fg"],
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.22", facecolor=st["badge_bg"], edgecolor=st["border"], lw=0.8),
            zorder=4
        )
        title_y = y + h/2 + 0.04
        sub_y = y + 0.22
    else:
        title_y = y + h/2 + 0.14 if subtitle else y + h/2
        sub_y = y + h/2 - 0.20

    ax.text(
        x + w/2, title_y,
        title,
        ha="center", va="center",
        fontsize=fontsize,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=st["title"],
        zorder=4
    )
    
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(
            x + w/2, sub_y,
            subtitle,
            ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=fontsize - 2.2,
            color=SUBTEXT_COLOR,
            zorder=4
        )

def draw_diamond(ax, cx, cy, rx, ry, text, fontsize=7.2):
    pts = [[cx, cy + ry], [cx + rx, cy], [cx, cy - ry], [cx - rx, cy]]
    poly = patches.Polygon(pts, closed=True, linewidth=1.5, edgecolor="#f59e0b", facecolor="#281e10", zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color="#fde047", zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, p1, p2, color="#38bdf8", lw=1.6, rad=0.0):
    conn = f"arc3,rad={rad}" if rad != 0 else "arc3,rad=0"
    ax.annotate(
        "",
        xy=p2, xytext=p1,
        arrowprops=dict(
            arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.32,head_length=0.42",
            color=color,
            lw=lw,
            shrinkA=4,
            shrinkB=4,
            connectionstyle=conn
        ),
        zorder=2
    )

def setup_header(ax, title, subtitle, w_total, y_top=11.5):
    ax.text(
        w_total / 2, y_top,
        title,
        ha="center", va="center",
        fontsize=16,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#ffffff",
        zorder=5
    )
    ax.text(
        w_total / 2, y_top - 0.45,
        subtitle,
        ha="center", va="center",
        fontsize=10.5,
        color="#38bdf8",
        zorder=5
    )

def copy_to_all(src_filename):
    art_path = os.path.join(ARTIFACT_DIR, src_filename)
    ws_path = os.path.join(WORKSPACE_DIR, src_filename)
    dl_path = os.path.join(DOWNLOADS_DIR, src_filename)
    if os.path.exists(art_path):
        shutil.copyfile(art_path, ws_path)
        shutil.copyfile(art_path, dl_path)
        print(f"Synced {src_filename} to workspace and Downloads.")

def draw_column_bridge(ax, x_start, y_start, x_end, y_end, gutter_x, badge_text="", color="#f43f5e", lw=1.8):
    ax.plot([x_start, gutter_x, gutter_x, x_end], [y_start, y_start, y_end, y_end], color=color, lw=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(
        "",
        xy=(x_end, y_end), xytext=(x_end - 0.35, y_end),
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.32,head_length=0.42", color=color, lw=lw),
        zorder=3
    )
    if badge_text:
        badge_y = (y_start + y_end) / 2
        ax.text(
            gutter_x, badge_y, badge_text,
            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=6.8, fontweight="bold",
            color="#fde047",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.18", facecolor="#18140f", edgecolor=color, lw=1.0),
            zorder=4

Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise (Leonida Keys) ### Mechanics & Structure - **Playable Character**: Strictly locked to **Jason** (with Lucia introduced in the Prologue and reunited in *"Coming Home"*). - **Core Narrative**: Petty smuggling, local debt enforcement for Brian, and settling in Key Lento following Lucia's release from Hamlet State Penitentiary. - **True 3-Branch Parallel Architecture**: After completing *"Gone Fishing"* ($140 mailbox cash pickup), the storyline opens into three concurrent operational tracks: 1. **Branch 1 (Cal & Brian Marina Jobs)**: *Unwanted Attention* ($200 mailbox cash pickup) $\rightarrow$ *Pipework*. 2. **Branch 2 (Brian Armory & Vehicle Repair)**: *Gear Up* $\rightarrow$ *Just a Scratch* (Ganado repair & respray; **Mandatory Story Gate**). 3. **Branch 3 (Rent Collection & Main Spine)**: *Lab Fees* $\rightarrow$ *Hey Arnold!* $\rightarrow$ *Feng Shui* (24h cooldown wait) $\rightarrow$ *Coming Home* (Lucia released from prison) $\rightarrow$ *Find Donnie's Package*. - **Decision Diamond 1 (Gate Check)**: Evaluates whether the player has completed *Just a Scratch*. If not completed, Joey places an urgent reminder call redirecting Jason back to clear the repair shop gate before *Buck Me* unlocks. - **Decision Diamond 2 (Smuggler Gate Check)**: Evaluates whether BOTH *Day Release* AND *Just a Scratch* are completed before Brian's call triggers *Swamped*. - **Chapter 1 Climax**: *Swamped* $\rightarrow$ *Doin' Gone* (clearing Donnie's trailer). The chapter cleanly terminates here with a hard narrative cut to Port Gellhorn. - **Speedrun Routing Note**: Clear Branch 1 (*Unwanted Attention* & *Pipework*) during the mandatory 24-hour waiting window triggered after *Feng Shui* to eliminate downtime. Verified Reference Data (`image_1188e9.jpg`) vs. Speculative Community Outlines Early community diagrams circulating online contained several critical errors and speculative extrapolations: 1. **Chapter 1 Climax is *Doin' Gone* (Not Speculative Missions 19–22)**: - The community flowchart `GTAVI_MISSION_FLOW1.jpg` mistakenly spelled this mission as `"DON GONE"`. Cross-referencing verified game strings and audio logs confirms the title is **"Doin' Gone"** (referencing Donnie's departure and cleaning out his trailer). - In speculative outlines, missions 19–22 (*Recalibration*, *Tourist Trap*, *Home Sweet Home*, *Discharge Time*) were extrapolated as Chapter 1 missions. Ground truth reference `image_1188e9.jpg` clearly terminates Chapter 1 at *Doin' Gone*, routing directly into the Port Gellhorn motel arrival (*What's in the Bag?*). 2. **True 3-Branch Parallel Structure**: - The storyline splits immediately after *Gone Fishing* into 3 concurrent branches (*Unwanted Attention*, *Gear Up*, *Lab Fees*). Forcing missions 1 to 22 into a linear chain misrepresents the game's actual Directed Acyclic Graph. 3. **The Two Explicit Decision Diamonds**: - **Diamond 1**: Evaluates whether *Just a Scratch* has been cleared prior to *Buck Me*. If skipped, an automated call from Joey intercepts progression. - **Diamond 2**: Evaluates whether both *Day Release* and *Just a Scratch* are completed before *Swamped* $\rightarrow$ *Doin' Gone*. ### 2. The Ending A $2,000,000 Payout Clarification - A common misconception in player communities is that Ending A (*Bonnie & Clyde*) requires $2,000,000 in the player's bank account to unlock. - **Fact**: Script analysis confirms that **$2,000,000 is the mission completion cash reward** paid out to Jason and Lucia upon successfully surviving the Coast Guard gauntlet, NOT an entry prerequisite. Players do not need to grind money before initiating the finale. ### 3. Strict Sequential Progression vs. Concurrent Parallel Strands - **Chapters 2 & 4 (Sequential Stages)**: Visual "wrap-around" diagonal arrows in older community flowcharts made Chapters 2 and 4 look like parallel faction branches. In reality, they are strict chronological stages (Stages 1 through 4) where each phase must be fully cleared before the next stage opens. - **Chapter 3 (True Parallel Faction Strands)**: Once the Vice City safehouse is unlocked in Mission 50, Tyrone (Strand 1), Boobie (Strand 2), and Raul (Strand 3) are active simultaneously as concurrent map pins. Furthermore, the Sinfrontera Bank Heist features 3 concurrent preparation tracks (Safecracker, Explosives, Codes & Van) that can be tackled in any order. ### 4. Any% Speedrun Optimization Summary - **Chapter 1 Downtime Optimization**: Run Branch 1 (*Unwanted Attention* $\rightarrow$ *Pipework*) while *Feng Shui*'s 24-hour waiting window elapses. - **Skip All Social / Hot Meter Activities**: Ignore *Get Haircut*, *Buy Necklace*, *Buy Flowers*, *Buy Groceries*, and *Lucia's Clothes*. - **Save $75,000 Cash**: Keep at least $75,000 from the Sinfrontera Bank Heist ($10.5M take) to instantly bypass Abe Gonzalez's wire transfer gate in Chapter 4 (*Party Hard*). - **Select Ending B (*The Deal*)**: Accepting Mendez's immunity plea skips the multi-stage offshore Coast Guard gunboat battle, saving **8 to 12 minutes of real-world time** in Any% speedruns.

# Grand Theft Auto VI: Campaign Mission Flow & Prerequisite Guide This document provides the definitive mission dependency graph, prerequisite unlock trees, character-switching milestones, heist setup pipelines, points of no return, and speedrun routing across all 5 story chapters of *Grand Theft Auto VI*. --- ## 1. High-Level Campaign Architecture The GTA VI storyline progresses through five distinct geographical and thematic narrative blocks. While open-world exploration is available between operations, missions operate in a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with key narrative bottlenecks connecting each chapter. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph C1B["Prologue & Chapter 1"] C1["Just Like Paradise

Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise (Leonida Keys) ### Mechanics & Structure - **Playable Character**: Strictly locked to **Jason** (with Lucia introduced in the Prologue and reunited in *"Coming Home"*). - **Core Narrative**: Petty smuggling, local debt enforcement for Brian, and settling in Key Lento following Lucia's release from Hamlet State Penitentiary. - **True 3-Branch Parallel Architecture**: After completing *"Gone Fishing"* ($140 mailbox cash pickup), the storyline opens into three concurrent operational tracks: 1. **Branch 1 (Cal & Brian Marina Jobs)**: *Unwanted Attention* ($200 mailbox cash pickup) $\rightarrow$ *Pipework*. 2. **Branch 2 (Brian Armory & Vehicle Repair)**: *Gear Up* $\rightarrow$ *Just a Scratch* (Ganado repair & respray; **Mandatory Story Gate**). 3. **Branch 3 (Rent Collection & Main Spine)**: *Lab Fees* $\rightarrow$ *Hey Arnold!* $\rightarrow$ *Feng Shui* (24h cooldown wait) $\rightarrow$ *Coming Home* (Lucia released from prison) $\rightarrow$ *Find Donnie's Package*. - **Decision Diamond 1 (Gate Check)**: Evaluates whether the player has completed *Just a Scratch*. If not completed, Joey places an urgent reminder call redirecting Jason back to clear the repair shop gate before *Buck Me* unlocks. - **Decision Diamond 2 (Smuggler Gate Check)**: Evaluates whether BOTH *Day Release* AND *Just a Scratch* are completed before Brian's call triggers *Swamped*. - **Chapter 1 Climax**: *Swamped* $\rightarrow$ *Doin' Gone* (clearing Donnie's trailer). The chapter cleanly terminates here with a hard narrative cut to Port Gellhorn. - **Speedrun Routing Note**: Clear Branch 1 (*Unwanted Attention* & *Pipework*) during the mandatory 24-hour waiting window triggered after *Feng Shui* to eliminate downtime. Verified Reference Data (`image_1188e9.jpg`) vs. Speculative Community Outlines Early community diagrams circulating online contained several critical errors and speculative extrapolations: 1. **Chapter 1 Climax is *Doin' Gone* (Not Speculative Missions 19–22)**: - The community flowchart `GTAVI_MISSION_FLOW1.jpg` mistakenly spelled this mission as `"DON GONE"`. Cross-referencing verified game strings and audio logs confirms the title is **"Doin' Gone"** (referencing Donnie's departure and cleaning out his trailer). - In speculative outlines, missions 19–22 (*Recalibration*, *Tourist Trap*, *Home Sweet Home*, *Discharge Time*) were extrapolated as Chapter 1 missions. Ground truth reference `image_1188e9.jpg` clearly terminates Chapter 1 at *Doin' Gone*, routing directly into the Port Gellhorn motel arrival (*What's in the Bag?*). 2. **True 3-Branch Parallel Structure**: - The storyline splits immediately after *Gone Fishing* into 3 concurrent branches (*Unwanted Attention*, *Gear Up*, *Lab Fees*). Forcing missions 1 to 22 into a linear chain misrepresents the game's actual Directed Acyclic Graph. 3. **The Two Explicit Decision Diamonds**: - **Diamond 1**: Evaluates whether *Just a Scratch* has been cleared prior to *Buck Me*. If skipped, an automated call from Joey intercepts progression. - **Diamond 2**: Evaluates whether both *Day Release* and *Just a Scratch* are completed before *Swamped* $\rightarrow$ *Doin' Gone*. ### 2. The Ending A $2,000,000 Payout Clarification - A common misconception in player communities is that Ending A (*Bonnie & Clyde*) requires $2,000,000 in the player's bank account to unlock. - **Fact**: Script analysis confirms that **$2,000,000 is the mission completion cash reward** paid out to Jason and Lucia upon successfully surviving the Coast Guard gauntlet, NOT an entry prerequisite. Players do not need to grind money before initiating the finale. ### 3. Strict Sequential Progression vs. Concurrent Parallel Strands - **Chapters 2 & 4 (Sequential Stages)**: Visual "wrap-around" diagonal arrows in older community flowcharts made Chapters 2 and 4 look like parallel faction branches. In reality, they are strict chronological stages (Stages 1 through 4) where each phase must be fully cleared before the next stage opens. - **Chapter 3 (True Parallel Faction Strands)**: Once the Vice City safehouse is unlocked in Mission 50, Tyrone (Strand 1), Boobie (Strand 2), and Raul (Strand 3) are active simultaneously as concurrent map pins. Furthermore, the Sinfrontera Bank Heist features 3 concurrent preparation tracks (Safecracker, Explosives, Codes & Van) that can be tackled in any order. ### 4. Any% Speedrun Optimization Summary - **Chapter 1 Downtime Optimization**: Run Branch 1 (*Unwanted Attention* $\rightarrow$ *Pipework*) while *Feng Shui*'s 24-hour waiting window elapses. - **Skip All Social / Hot Meter Activities**: Ignore *Get Haircut*, *Buy Necklace*, *Buy Flowers*, *Buy Groceries*, and *Lucia's Clothes*. - **Save $75,000 Cash**: Keep at least $75,000 from the Sinfrontera Bank Heist ($10.5M take) to instantly bypass Abe Gonzalez's wire transfer gate in Chapter 4 (*Party Hard*). - **Select Ending B (*The Deal*)**: Accepting Mendez's immunity plea skips the multi-stage offshore Coast Guard gunboat battle, saving **8 to 12 minutes of real-world time** in Any% speedruns.

In the context of Rockstar Games file formats (specifically *Red Dead Redemption 2* and the RAGE engine), **RPF8** is the archive version format used for game files (following RPF7 used in *GTA V*)[1]. 

When looking into GitHub repositories handling RPF8 and RPF archive encryption types (such as `rpf-archive` libraries, community format docs, or toolkits like OpenIV/CodeWalker derivatives), the structure and encryption parameters typically break down as follows:

### 1. Encryption Types Header Fields
In RAGE RPF archives (including RPF7 and RPF8 formats), internal structure headers specify how individual entries or blocks are encrypted. Across open-source parsers on GitHub, these encryption types are generally grouped into four main constants[2]:
* **`NONE`**: Unencrypted data blocks.
* **`OPEN`**: Designated by the magic string `"OPEN"`. Modded files often ship as `OPEN` so that the game engine can read them without requiring proprietary re-encryption keys[2].
* **`AES`**: Advanced Encryption Standard blocks (less commonly used for main asset files in later RAGE iterations)[3].
* **`NG`**: Rockstar's custom "New Generation" encryption scheme utilized heavily in modern RAGE titles (*GTA V*, *RDR2*)[2][3]. 

### 2. Key Differences in RPF8 (*RDR2*)
While RPF7 (*GTA V*) keys and structures are extensively mapped out in open-source tooling, **RPF8** introduced structural alterations:
* **Hash-based Entries:** Unlike older iterations where file paths or names were stored more explicitly within specific lookup tables, RPF8 entries are heavily indexed and keyed by hashes rather than plain text names. External nametables are typically required to map hashes back to readable asset paths[2].
* **Read vs. Write limitations:** Open-source libraries can readily implement decryption routines for RPF8/NG formats because key constants or patterns can be extracted/scanned from the game executable (`RDR2.exe`)[3]. However, full re-encryption or creation of native-encrypted NG files remains an asymmetrical challenge ("read NG = easy, write NG = the wall") because the specific generation/encryption tables are not natively embedded in standard binaries[2].

### Relevant GitHub Ecosystem Projects
If you are looking for codebases dealing with these specifications, look into:
* **`rpf-archive` / `rage-rpf` (Rust libraries):** Handles reading/writing across RPF0 through RPF8 formats, detailing format magic values and parsing structures[1][4].
* **CodeWalker / gta-toolkit derivatives:** Contain historical implementations of key-Scanning (`GTAKeys.cs`) and RAGE architecture parsing logic that map over into RDR2 research[3].

import os
import re

scripts_dir = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\americas_scripts_23_11_2026"

def analyze_story_strings():
    story_file = os.path.join(scripts_dir, "story000.ysc.cs")
    strings_found = set()
    native_calls = set()
    
    with open(story_file, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for line in f:
            # find string literals
            for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"\\]*(?:\\.[^"\\]*)*)"', line):
                val = m.group(1)
                if len(val) >= 3 and not val.startswith("type_"):
                    strings_found.add(val)
            # find Native calls
            for m in re.finditer(r'Native\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', line):
                native_calls.add(f"{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)}")
                
    print(f"story000 strings count: {len(strings_found)}")
    print("Sample strings:")
    for s in sorted(list(strings_found))[:50]:
        print("  ", s)
        
    print(f"\nstory000 native calls count: {len(native_calls)}")
    print("Sample native calls:")
    for n in sorted(list(native_calls))[:50]:
        print("  ", n)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    analyze_story_strings()

import os
import re
from collections import Counter

scripts_dir = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\americas_scripts_23_11_2026"

def scan_all_scripts():
    all_strings = Counter()
    mission_strings = {}
    
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(scripts_dir) if f.endswith(".ysc.cs") and f != "shared.ysc.cs"]
    print(f"Total files to scan (excluding shared.ysc.cs): {len(files)}")
    
    # Patterns of interest:
    # 1. Mission names or titles
    # 2. Cutscene names, audio scenes, subtitles, speech
    # 3. Blip names, objective text
    # 4. Hash mappings
    
    for filename in files:
        filepath = os.path.join(scripts_dir, filename)
        file_strings = set()
        with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
            for line in f:
                # check string literals
                matches = re.findall(r'"([^"\\]*(?:\\.[^"\\]*)*)"', line)
                for s in matches:
                    if len(s) >= 4 and not s.startswith("type_") and not s.startswith("box<") and not s.startswith("try_cast<") and not "System." in s and not "InvalidOperationException" in s:
                        file_strings.add(s)
        if file_strings:
            mission_strings[filename] = file_strings
            for s in file_strings:
                all_strings[s] += 1
                
    print(f"Files with strings: {len(mission_strings)}")
    print(f"Total unique strings found: {len(all_strings)}")
    
    # Print the most interesting strings (strings with letters and spaces or underscores, or looking like mission names)
    interesting = []
    for s, count in all_strings.items():
        if re.search(r'[A-Za-z]', s):
            interesting.append((s, count))
            
    interesting.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].lower())
    print("\nSample unique strings found in scripts (first 100):")
    for s, c in interesting[:100]:
        print(f"  [{c} files] {s}")
        
    # Write all interesting strings to a file in scratch
    out_path = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c\scratch\decompiled_script_strings.txt"
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        for s, c in interesting:
            out.write(f"{c}\t{s}\n")
    print(f"\nWritten {len(interesting)} strings to {out_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    scan_all_scripts()

def joaat(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s.lower().encode('utf-8'):
        h = (h + c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h + (h << 10)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h ^ (h >> 6)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h ^ (h >> 11)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 15)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h

import json

fp = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK\output\mission_order.json"
with open(fp, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    d = json.load(f)

for link in d["replay_menu_cross_mission_links"]:
    print(link)

print("\n=== MISSIONS IN REPLAY MENU (97) ===")
for m in d["missions"]:
    idx = m.get("unique_mission_index")
    mid = m.get("id")
    ch = m.get("texture_chapter_tag")
    pos = m.get("replay_menu_position")
    name = m.get("name", "")
    print(f"Ch{ch} [Idx {idx:3d} | Pos {pos:2d}] {mid:25s} -> {name}")

print("\n=== CMISSIONS ENTRIES NOT IN REPLAY MENU (50) ===")
for item in d["cmissions_entries_not_in_replay_menu"]:
    idx = item.get("unique_mission_index")
    mid = item.get("id")
    ch = item.get("texture_chapter_tag")
    print(f"Ch{ch} [Idx {idx:3d}] {mid}")

import os
import re
import json

def joaat(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s.lower().encode('utf-8'):
        h = (h + c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h + (h << 10)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h ^ (h >> 6)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h ^ (h >> 11)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 15)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h

scripts_dir = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\americas_scripts_23_11_2026"
hash_order_file = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK\output\mission_order.json"

with open(hash_order_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    d = json.load(f)

# Collect all potential candidate strings
candidate_strings = set()
for m in d["missions"]:
    candidate_strings.add(m.get("id", ""))
for item in d["cmissions_entries_not_in_replay_menu"]:
    candidate_strings.add(item.get("id", ""))

# Also add variations: lowercase, stripped underscores, prefixed with "mission_", etc.
expanded = set()
for s in candidate_strings:
    if not s: continue
    expanded.add(s)
    expanded.add(s.lower())
    expanded.add(s.replace("_", ""))
    expanded.add(s.lower().replace("_", ""))
    expanded.add(f"mission_{s.lower()}")
    expanded.add(f"m_{s.lower()}")
    expanded.add(f"sp_{s.lower()}")
    expanded.add(f"story_{s.lower()}")

flowchart_names = [

    "clb_scuff", "com_cbo_cbint", "rob_drive", "bil_red", "rob_boat_j", "rob_bank",
    "cti_show_hath", "ban_setup", "ban_rescu", "clb_steal", "ban_explo", "ban_carte",
    "ban_safe", "clb_video", "clb_tower", "ban_pkbmb", "ban_final",
    "mny_hotel", "sfh_taxi", "mny_car", "csc_dig_data", "mny_party", "air_tail",
    "clb_heli", "ao_show_l_exp", "com_show_trailer", "air_train", "clb_promo", "air_beach",
    "air_bus", "air_gang", "air_scope", "mny_escrt", "clb_evi", "air_truck", "mny_kidnp",
    "clb_party", "air_drone", "air_hack", "air_recru", "air_cater", "air_final",
    "rob_death", "bil_confr", "coa_helis", "bil_boss", "bil_preg", "coa_dog",

]
for n in flowchart_names:

    expanded.add(n.replace("_", ""))

# Read VmProgram of all files
file_programs = {}
files = [f for f in os.listdir(scripts_dir) if f.endswith(".ysc.cs")]
for fn in files:
    fp = os.path.join(scripts_dir, fn)
    with open(fp, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for _ in range(30):
            line = f.readline()
            m = re.search(r'\[VmProgram\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)U?\)\]', line)
            if m:
                prog_hash = int(m.group(1), 16)
                file_programs[prog_hash] = fn

print(f"Total compiled script files with VmProgram: {len(file_programs)}")

# Match candidate strings

"""Print per-function mission reference summaries for one script from the decomp_mission_refs index."""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("index_json", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("script_name")
    parser.add_argument("--names", type=int, default=14)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    index = json.loads(args.index_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    functions = index.get(args.script_name)
    if functions is None:
        print(f"No references recorded for {args.script_name}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    for function, entries in sorted(functions.items(), key=lambda item: item[1][0][0]):
        ordered = []
        for _, name in entries:
            if name not in ordered:
                ordered.append(name)

        shown = ", ".join(ordered[:args.names])
        suffix = " ..." if len(ordered) > args.names else ""
        print(f"{function} lines {entries[0][0]}..{entries[-1][0]} hits={len(entries)} missions={len(ordered)}: "

import json
import os
from collections import defaultdict

base = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK"
refs_file = os.path.join(base, "work", "decomp_mission_refs.json")
order_file = os.path.join(base, "output", "mission_order.json")

with open(refs_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    refs = json.load(f)

with open(order_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    order_doc = json.load(f)

# Map mission ID to chapter and name
mission_meta = {}
for m in order_doc["missions"]:
    mid = m.get("id")
    mission_meta[mid] = {
        "chapter": m.get("chapter_or_act", "Unknown"),
        "texture_ch": m.get("texture_chapter_tag", 0),
        "idx": m.get("unique_mission_index", -1),
        "pos": m.get("replay_menu_position", -1)
    }

for item in order_doc["cmissions_entries_not_in_replay_menu"]:
    mid = item.get("id")
    if mid not in mission_meta:
        mission_meta[mid] = {
            "chapter": f"Ch{item.get('texture_chapter_tag', 0)} (Table Only)",
            "texture_ch": item.get("texture_chapter_tag", 0),
            "idx": item.get("unique_mission_index", -1),
            "pos": -1
        }

# Reverse mapping: mission -> list of scripts
mission_to_scripts = defaultdict(list)
for script_name, func_map in refs.items():
    # collect all missions referenced in this script
    script_missions = set()
    total_hits = 0
    for func, hit_list in func_map.items():
        for line, mid in hit_list:
            script_missions.add(mid)
            total_hits += 1
    for mid in script_missions:
        mission_to_scripts[mid].append((script_name, total_hits, len(func_map)))

print(f"Total missions referenced across decompiled scripts: {len(mission_to_scripts)}")

# Print report organized by chapter
by_ch = defaultdict(list)
for mid, scripts in mission_to_scripts.items():
    meta = mission_meta.get(mid, {"chapter": "Unknown", "idx": -1})
    by_ch[meta["chapter"]].append((meta["idx"], mid, scripts))

for ch in sorted(by_ch.keys()):
    print(f"\n==========================================")
    print(f"   {ch}")
    print(f"==========================================")
    for idx, mid, scripts in sorted(by_ch[ch], key=lambda x: x[0]):
        print(f"[{idx:3d}] {mid} ({len(scripts)} scripts referencing)")
        for sname, hits, funcs in sorted(scripts, key=lambda x: -x[1])[:3]:
            print(f"       -> {sname} (hits: {hits}, funcs: {funcs})")

# Also write to scratch file for reference
out_path = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c\scratch\mission_to_decompiled_scripts.json"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump({m: [s[0] for s in slist] for m, slist in mission_to_scripts.items()}, f, indent=2)
print(f"\nSaved full mapping to {out_path}")

"""
Extract the mission dependency graph from the decompiled scripts and game data files.

Sources used (all from the game files, nothing external):
1. cmissions.xml - CMissions table with UniqueMissionIndex and MissionId
2. progress_missions.json - Replay menu layout with chapter filters and unlock_id links
3. mission_order.json - Merged mission registry with chapter assignments
4. decomp_mission_refs.json - Which decompiled scripts reference which missions
5. 0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs - Master dispatcher script (func_109E09, func_12EB6F, func_24BCE4)
6. story000.ysc.cs - Story state machine
"""

import json
import os
import re
from collections import defaultdict

SCRIPTS_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\americas_scripts_23_11_2026"
WORK_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK\work"
OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK\output"
SCRATCH_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c\scratch"


def joaat(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s.lower().encode("utf-8"):
        h = (h + c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h + (h << 10)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h ^ (h >> 6)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h ^ (h >> 11)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 15)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h


def build_hash_table():
    """Build complete hash -> mission name table from all known mission IDs."""
    with open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "mission_order.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        order_doc = json.load(f)

    hash_to_name = {}
    name_to_meta = {}

    for m in order_doc["missions"]:
        mid = m["id"]
        h = joaat(mid)
        hash_to_name[h] = mid
        name_to_meta[mid] = {
            "chapter": m.get("chapter_or_act", "Unknown"),
            "idx": m.get("unique_mission_index", -1),
            "pos": m.get("replay_menu_position", -1),
        }

    for item in order_doc["cmissions_entries_not_in_replay_menu"]:
        mid = item["id"]
        h = joaat(mid)
        hash_to_name[h] = mid
        if mid not in name_to_meta:
            name_to_meta[mid] = {
                "chapter": "Ch{} (Table Only)".format(item.get("texture_chapter_tag", 0)),
                "idx": item.get("unique_mission_index", -1),
                "pos": -1,
            }

    return hash_to_name, name_to_meta


def extract_dispatcher_hashes():
    """Extract all 32-bit constant hashes from the master dispatcher script."""
    dispatcher = os.path.join(SCRIPTS_DIR, "0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs")

    # Pattern to find store_i32(..., 0x<HASH>) and comparisons like as_i32(0x<HASH>)
    hash_pattern = re.compile(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})")

    # Read the file and extract hashes from the dispatcher functions
    # func_109E09 starts around line 548000+, func_12EB6F, func_24BCE4
    hashes_by_function = defaultdict(list)
    current_func = None

    line_count = 0
    with open(dispatcher, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for line in f:
            line_count += 1
            # Track function boundaries
            func_match = re.search(r"\[VmFunction\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)\]", line)
            if func_match:
                current_func = "func_" + func_match.group(1)[2:]  # Strip 0x prefix

            if current_func and "store_i32" in line:
                for m in hash_pattern.finditer(line):
                    val = int(m.group(1), 16)
                    # Filter out small values and obvious non-mission hashes
                    if val > 0x1000 and val != 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        hashes_by_function[current_func].append((line_count, val))

            if current_func and "as_i32" in line:
                for m in hash_pattern.finditer(line):
                    val = int(m.group(1), 16)
                    if val > 0x1000 and val != 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        hashes_by_function[current_func].append((line_count, val))

    return hashes_by_function


def extract_story000_state_checks():
    """Extract mission hash checks from story000.ysc.cs to find state transitions."""
    story_file = os.path.join(SCRIPTS_DIR, "story000.ysc.cs")

    hash_pattern = re.compile(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})")
    checks_by_function = defaultdict(list)
    current_func = None
    line_count = 0

    with open(story_file, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for line in f:
            line_count += 1
            func_match = re.search(r"\[VmFunction\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)\]", line)
            if func_match:
                current_func = "func_" + func_match.group(1)[2:]

            if current_func and ("store_i32" in line or "as_i32" in line):
                for m in hash_pattern.finditer(line):
                    val = int(m.group(1), 16)
                    if val > 0x1000 and val != 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        checks_by_function[current_func].append((line_count, val))

    return checks_by_function


def extract_per_mission_script_dependencies():
    """
    For each mission's dedicated script, check which other mission IDs it references.
    This reveals direct dependencies (e.g., a mission script checking if another mission is complete).
    """
    with open(os.path.join(WORK_DIR, "decomp_mission_refs.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        refs = json.load(f)

    # Build reverse: for each script, what missions does it reference?
    # Then for each mission, what other missions does its dedicated script check?
    # We know mission X's dedicated script from the mapping (the script with most hits for that mission)

    hash_to_name, name_to_meta = build_hash_table()

    # Find the "primary" script for each mission (excludes the shared dispatcher 0xD260...)
    mission_primary_script = {}
    for script_name, func_map in refs.items():
        if script_name == "0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs":
            continue
        if script_name == "shared.ysc.cs":
            continue

        missions_in_script = set()
        total_hits = 0
        for func, hit_list in func_map.items():
            for _, mid in hit_list:
                missions_in_script.add(mid)
                total_hits += 1

        # If a script predominantly references one mission, it's that mission's script
        if len(missions_in_script) == 1:
            mission = list(missions_in_script)[0]
            if mission not in mission_primary_script or total_hits > mission_primary_script[mission][1]:
                mission_primary_script[mission] = (script_name, total_hits)

    # For multi-mission scripts, assign to the one with most hits
    for script_name, func_map in refs.items():
        if script_name in ("0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs", "shared.ysc.cs", "story000.ysc.cs"):
            continue

        mission_hit_count = defaultdict(int)
        for func, hit_list in func_map.items():
            for _, mid in hit_list:
                mission_hit_count[mid] += 1

        if mission_hit_count:
            top_mission = max(mission_hit_count, key=lambda m: mission_hit_count[m])
            if top_mission not in mission_primary_script:
                mission_primary_script[top_mission] = (script_name, mission_hit_count[top_mission])

    # Now, for each mission's primary script, what OTHER missions does it reference?
    dependencies = {}
    for mission, (script_name, _) in mission_primary_script.items():
        func_map = refs.get(script_name, {})
        other_missions = set()
        for func, hit_list in func_map.items():
            for _, mid in hit_list:
                if mid != mission:
                    other_missions.add(mid)
        if other_missions:
            dependencies[mission] = {
                "script": script_name,
                "references": sorted(other_missions),
            }

    return mission_primary_script, dependencies


def extract_progress_menu_dependencies():
    """
    Extract dependencies from the progress/replay menu data.
    When unlock_id != item_id, it means the mission reveals in menu only after unlock_id completes.
    """
    with open(os.path.join(WORK_DIR, "progress_missions.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        pm = json.load(f)

    unlock_links = []
    menu_order = {}

    for chapter_filter in pm:
        filter_id = chapter_filter.get("filter_id", "")
        items = chapter_filter.get("items", [])
        for item in items:
            label = item.get("label", "")
            item_id = item.get("item_id", "")
            unlock_id = item.get("unlock_id", "")
            pos = item.get("position", -1)

            menu_order[(filter_id, pos)] = label

            # When unlock_id differs from item_id, there's a cross-link
            if unlock_id and item_id and unlock_id.lower() != item_id.lower():
                unlock_links.append({
                    "menu_entry": label,
                    "item_id": item_id,
                    "unlock_id": unlock_id,
                    "chapter": filter_id,
                })

    return unlock_links, menu_order


def main():
    print("=" * 80)
    print("GTA VI MISSION DEPENDENCY GRAPH EXTRACTION")
    print("Sources: Xbox build files + decompiled scripts ONLY")
    print("=" * 80)

    hash_to_name, name_to_meta = build_hash_table()
    print(f"\nTotal mission IDs in hash table: {len(hash_to_name)}")

    # 1. Progress menu unlock links
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 1: REPLAY MENU UNLOCK CROSS-LINKS")
    print("=" * 60)
    unlock_links, menu_order = extract_progress_menu_dependencies()
    for link in unlock_links:
        print("  {} (item_id={}) unlocked by {} in {}".format(
            link["menu_entry"], link["item_id"], link["unlock_id"], link["chapter"]
        ))

    # 2. Per-mission script cross-references
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 2: MISSION SCRIPT CROSS-REFERENCES")
    print("(Each mission's dedicated script checking other mission states)")
    print("=" * 60)
    primary_scripts, cross_deps = extract_per_mission_script_dependencies()

    for mission in sorted(cross_deps.keys()):
        info = cross_deps[mission]
        meta = name_to_meta.get(mission, {})
        ch = meta.get("chapter", "?")
        print("  {} [{}] (script: {})".format(mission, ch, info["script"]))
        print("    references: {}".format(", ".join(info["references"])))

    # 3. Resolve hashes in dispatcher functions to build flow
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 3: DISPATCHER FUNCTION HASH RESOLUTION")
    print("(0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs - func_109E09 and others)")
    print("=" * 60)

    dispatcher_hashes = extract_dispatcher_hashes()

    # Focus on the key functions that the decomp_mission_refs identified
    key_funcs = [
        "func_109E09",  # 193 hits - main mission state dispatcher
        "func_12EB6F",  # 42 hits - secondary dispatcher
        "func_24BCE4",  # 31 hits - tertiary dispatcher
        "func_10AA55",  # 24 hits - chapter transition handler
        "func_29F224",  # 10 hits - mission group check
    ]

    for func_name in key_funcs:
        if func_name not in dispatcher_hashes:
            continue
        entries = dispatcher_hashes[func_name]
        resolved = []
        unresolved = []
        for line_num, h in entries:
            # Handle signed 32-bit (the decompiler uses 0xFFFFFFFF prefix for negatives)
            name = hash_to_name.get(h)
            if not name and h > 0x80000000:
                name = hash_to_name.get(h)
            if name:
                resolved.append((line_num, h, name))
            else:
                unresolved.append((line_num, h))

        print(f"\n  {func_name}: {len(entries)} hash constants, {len(resolved)} resolved, {len(unresolved)} unresolved")
        for line_num, h, name in resolved[:30]:
            meta = name_to_meta.get(name, {})
            print("    L{}: 0x{:08X} -> {} [{}]".format(line_num, h, name, meta.get("chapter", "?")))

    # 4. Extract story000 state machine
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 4: STORY000.YSC.CS STATE MACHINE HASH RESOLUTION")
    print("=" * 60)

    story_checks = extract_story000_state_checks()
    story_resolved_total = 0
    funcs_with_missions = []
    for func_name, entries in story_checks.items():
        resolved = [(ln, h, hash_to_name[h]) for ln, h in entries if h in hash_to_name]
        if resolved:
            funcs_with_missions.append((func_name, resolved, len(entries)))
            story_resolved_total += len(resolved)

    print(f"  Functions with mission hash references: {len(funcs_with_missions)}")
    print(f"  Total resolved mission hashes: {story_resolved_total}")
    for func_name, resolved, total in sorted(funcs_with_missions, key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))[:15]:
        missions = sorted(set(r[2] for r in resolved))
        print(f"  {func_name}: {len(resolved)}/{total} resolved -> {', '.join(missions[:8])}")

    # 5. Build the final dependency graph
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 5: RECONSTRUCTED MISSION ORDER & DEPENDENCIES")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Using replay menu position as the canonical ordering within each chapter
    with open(os.path.join(WORK_DIR, "progress_missions.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        pm = json.load(f)

    chapter_names = {
        "missions_chapter_1": "Chapter 1",
        "missions_chapter_2": "Chapter 2",
        "missions_chapter_3": "Chapter 3",
        "missions_chapter_4": "Chapter 4",
        "missions_chapter_5": "Chapter 5",
    }

    full_graph = {}

    for chapter_filter in pm:
        filter_id = chapter_filter.get("filter_id", "")
        ch_name = chapter_names.get(filter_id, filter_id)
        items = chapter_filter.get("items", [])
        print(f"\n  {ch_name} ({len(items)} missions in replay menu)")

        prev_mission = None
        for item in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x.get("position", 0)):
            label = item.get("label", "")
            item_id = item.get("item_id", "")
            unlock_id = item.get("unlock_id", "")
            pos = item.get("position", -1)
            known = item.get("is_known_mission", False)

            # Determine dependencies
            deps = []
            if prev_mission:
                deps.append(prev_mission)

            # Check if unlock_id links to another mission
            unlock_note = ""
            if unlock_id and unlock_id.lower() != item_id.lower():
                unlock_note = " (menu unlock: {})".format(unlock_id.upper())

            # Check cross-references from the script
            script_refs = ""
            if label in cross_deps:
                refs_list = cross_deps[label]["references"]
                if refs_list:
                    script_refs = " [script refs: {}]".format(", ".join(refs_list[:5]))

            # Variant info
            meta = name_to_meta.get(label, {})
            idx = meta.get("idx", -1)

            print("    [{:2d}] {:3d}. {:25s} known={}{}{}".format(
                pos, idx, label, known, unlock_note, script_refs
            ))

            full_graph[label] = {
                "chapter": ch_name,
                "position": pos,
                "index": idx,
                "deps": deps,
                "is_known": known,
            }
            prev_mission = label

    # 6. Identify mission variants and branching points
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 6: MISSION VARIANTS & BRANCHING POINTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    variant_groups = {
        "FT_AMUCO": ["FT_AMUCO_FIRST_INTERACTION", "FT_AMUCO_SECOND_INTERACTION"],
        "FT_KMODSHP": ["FT_KMODSHP_FIRST", "FT_KMODSHP_SECOND"],
        "INT_PRISO": ["INT_PRISO_TRIGGER_EARLY", "INT_PRISO_TRIGGER_LATE"],
        "BIL_PICK": ["BIL_PICK_DAY_TIME_START", "BIL_PICK_NIGHT_TIME_START"],
        "BIL_MOTEL": ["BIL_MOTEL_NON_VIOLENT", "BIL_MOTEL_VIOLENT"],
        "ANT_INTRO": ["ANT_INTRO_APARTMENT", "ANT_INTRO_STORAGE"],
        "ROB_BOAT_J": ["ROB_BOAT_J_JASON"],
        "MNY_HOTEL": ["MNY_HOTEL_AUTOLAUNCH"],
        "MNY_KIDNP": ["MNY_KIDNP_AUTO-LAUNCH"],
        "AIR_CATER": ["AIR_CATER_DHF", "AIR_CATER_DHP", "AIR_CATER_DHS"],
        "AIR_FINAL": ["AIR_FINAL_DATA_HACK_FAILED", "AIR_FINAL_DATA_HACK_PASSED"],
        "BIL_PENT": ["BIL_PENT_M_MENDEZ", "BIL_PENT_B_BRIAN"],
    }

    for parent, variants in sorted(variant_groups.items()):
        parent_meta = name_to_meta.get(parent, {})
        print("  {} [{}]:".format(parent, parent_meta.get("chapter", "?")))
        for v in variants:
            v_meta = name_to_meta.get(v, {})
            print("    -> {} [idx={}]".format(v, v_meta.get("idx", "?")))

    # 7. Finale branching
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SECTION 7: FINALE BRANCHING")
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  BIL_PENT (97) -> Final mission with branching:")
    print("    -> BIL_PENT_M_MENDEZ (102) - Ending M (Mendez path)")
    print("    -> BIL_PENT_B_BRIAN (103) - Ending B (Brian path)")
    print("  BIL_FINALE_M (144) - Finale variant M")

"""
Deep analysis of func_109E09 in 0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs to extract
the actual prerequisite checking pattern.

The dispatcher function appears to be a large switch-case on mission IDs.
For each mission, it checks whether certain prerequisite missions are complete
(via Method_1 = check state) and sets flags (via Method_0 = set state).
"""

import os
import re
import json
from collections import defaultdict, OrderedDict

SCRIPTS_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\americas_scripts_23_11_2026"
OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\Downloads\GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK\output"
SCRATCH_DIR = r"C:\Users\<user>\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\96252013-4633-45e8-b6a2-59b18be9e68c\scratch"


def joaat(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s.lower().encode("utf-8"):
        h = (h + c) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h + (h << 10)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = (h ^ (h >> 6)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h ^ (h >> 11)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = (h + (h << 15)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h


def build_hash_table():
    with open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "mission_order.json"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        order_doc = json.load(f)
    hash_to_name = {}
    name_to_meta = {}
    for m in order_doc["missions"]:
        mid = m["id"]
        hash_to_name[joaat(mid)] = mid
        name_to_meta[mid] = m.get("chapter_or_act", "?")
    for item in order_doc["cmissions_entries_not_in_replay_menu"]:
        mid = item["id"]
        hash_to_name[joaat(mid)] = mid
        if mid not in name_to_meta:
            name_to_meta[mid] = "Ch{} (table)".format(item.get("texture_chapter_tag", 0))
    return hash_to_name, name_to_meta


def analyze_dispatcher_blocks():
    """
    Read func_109E09 and parse the control flow to find:
    - Switch cases on mission IDs (compare local_0 to hash)
    - Within each case: Method_1 calls (checks) and Method_0 calls (sets)
    """
    hash_to_name, name_to_meta = build_hash_table()
    dispatcher = os.path.join(SCRIPTS_DIR, "0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs")

    # Read the entire func_109E09 region
    # From decomp_mission_refs: func_109E09 covers lines ~548000..573000+
    # Let's find the exact range

    in_func = False
    func_lines = []
    start_line = 0

    with open(dispatcher, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for idx, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            if "[VmFunction(0x109E09)]" in line:
                in_func = True
                start_line = idx
                continue
            if in_func:
                if line.strip().startswith("[VmFunction(") and "0x109E09" not in line:
                    break
                func_lines.append((idx, line.rstrip()))

    print("func_109E09: {} lines (starting at L{})".format(len(func_lines), start_line))

    # Parse the control flow:
    # Pattern 1: Switch dispatch - as_i32(local_0) == as_i32(0xHASH) -> goto label
    # Pattern 2: Method_0(ptr, hash, 1) = set mission state flag
    # Pattern 3: Method_1(ptr, hash, 1) = check mission state flag (returns bool)

    hash_re = re.compile(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})")
    switch_re = re.compile(r"as_i32\(local_0\)\s*==\s*as_i32\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")
    switch_gt_re = re.compile(r"as_i32\(local_0\)\s*>\s*as_i32\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")
    method0_re = re.compile(r"Method_0\(.*?,\s*(.*?)\[0\],\s*1\)")
    method1_re = re.compile(r"Method_1\(.*?,\s*(.*?)\[0\],\s*1\)")
    store_i32_re = re.compile(r"store_i32\(.*?,\s*0x0,\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")
    label_re = re.compile(r"^(\s*label_[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\s*;")

    # Track: which hash is being switched on, and within that block, what's checked/set
    current_switch_hash = None
    current_switch_name = None
    current_block_checks = []  # Method_1 calls (prerequisite checks)
    current_block_sets = []  # Method_0 calls (state sets)
    last_stored_hash = None

    blocks = []  # (switch_name, checks, sets)

    for line_num, line in func_lines:
        # Detect switch comparison
        sw = switch_re.search(line)
        if sw:
            # Save previous block
            if current_switch_name:
                blocks.append((current_switch_name, current_switch_hash,
                               list(current_block_checks), list(current_block_sets)))
                current_block_checks = []
                current_block_sets = []

            raw_hash = int(sw.group(1), 16)
            current_switch_hash = raw_hash
            current_switch_name = hash_to_name.get(raw_hash, "UNKNOWN_0x{:08X}".format(raw_hash))
            continue

        # Detect store_i32 for hash constants
        st = store_i32_re.search(line)
        if st:
            last_stored_hash = int(st.group(1), 16)
            continue

        # Detect Method_0 (set state)
        if "Method_0(" in line and last_stored_hash:
            name = hash_to_name.get(last_stored_hash, "0x{:08X}".format(last_stored_hash))
            current_block_sets.append(name)
            last_stored_hash = None
            continue

        # Detect Method_1 (check state)
        if "Method_1(" in line and last_stored_hash:
            name = hash_to_name.get(last_stored_hash, "0x{:08X}".format(last_stored_hash))
            current_block_checks.append(name)
            last_stored_hash = None
            continue

    # Save last block
    if current_switch_name:
        blocks.append((current_switch_name, current_switch_hash,
                       list(current_block_checks), list(current_block_sets)))

    # Print analysis
    print("\n=== DISPATCHER BLOCKS (switch cases) ===")
    print("Each block: when mission X completes, it checks/sets other mission flags\n")

    dependency_edges = []

    for switch_name, switch_hash, checks, sets in blocks:
        ch = name_to_meta.get(switch_name, "?")
        if not checks and not sets:
            continue
        print("{} [{}]:".format(switch_name, ch))
        if checks:
            print("  CHECKS (prerequisites): {}".format(", ".join(checks)))
            for c in checks:
                dependency_edges.append({"from": c, "to": switch_name, "type": "check"})
        if sets:
            print("  SETS (unlocks): {}".format(", ".join(sets)))
            for s in sets:
                dependency_edges.append({"from": switch_name, "to": s, "type": "set"})
        print()

    # Save edges
    out_path = os.path.join(SCRATCH_DIR, "dispatcher_dependency_edges.json")
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(dependency_edges, f, indent=2)
    print("Saved {} dependency edges to {}".format(len(dependency_edges), out_path))

    return blocks, dependency_edges


def analyze_func_10AA55():
    """Analyze the chapter transition handler."""
    hash_to_name, name_to_meta = build_hash_table()
    dispatcher = os.path.join(SCRIPTS_DIR, "0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs")

    in_func = False
    func_lines = []

    with open(dispatcher, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for idx, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            if "[VmFunction(0x10AA55)]" in line:
                in_func = True
                continue
            if in_func:
                if line.strip().startswith("[VmFunction(") and "0x10AA55" not in line:
                    break
                func_lines.append((idx, line.rstrip()))

    print("\n\n=== func_10AA55 (Chapter Transition Handler) ===")
    print("Lines: {}".format(len(func_lines)))

    store_i32_re = re.compile(r"store_i32\(.*?,\s*0x0,\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")
    switch_re = re.compile(r"as_i32\(.*?\)\s*==\s*as_i32\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")

    last_stored_hash = None
    for line_num, line in func_lines:
        st = store_i32_re.search(line)
        if st:
            h = int(st.group(1), 16)
            name = hash_to_name.get(h, "0x{:08X}".format(h))
            print("  L{}: store hash -> {}".format(line_num, name))

        sw = switch_re.search(line)
        if sw:
            h = int(sw.group(1), 16)
            name = hash_to_name.get(h, "0x{:08X}".format(h))
            print("  L{}: compare == {}".format(line_num, name))

        if "Method_0(" in line:
            print("  L{}: SET STATE".format(line_num))
        if "Method_1(" in line:
            print("  L{}: CHECK STATE".format(line_num))
        if "goto " in line:
            label = line.strip()
            if "goto label_" in label:
                print("  L{}: {}".format(line_num, label))


def analyze_func_24BCE4():
    """Analyze the third dispatcher function."""
    hash_to_name, name_to_meta = build_hash_table()
    dispatcher = os.path.join(SCRIPTS_DIR, "0xD2601E252151E04B.ysc.cs")

    in_func = False
    func_lines = []

    with open(dispatcher, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        for idx, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            if "[VmFunction(0x24BCE4)]" in line:
                in_func = True
                continue
            if in_func:
                if line.strip().startswith("[VmFunction(") and "0x24BCE4" not in line:
                    break
                func_lines.append((idx, line.rstrip()))

    print("\n\n=== func_24BCE4 (Tertiary Dispatcher) ===")
    print("Lines: {}".format(len(func_lines)))

    store_i32_re = re.compile(r"store_i32\(.*?,\s*0x0,\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")
    switch_re = re.compile(r"as_i32\(.*?\)\s*==\s*as_i32\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\)")

    for line_num, line in func_lines:
        st = store_i32_re.search(line)
        if st:
            h = int(st.group(1), 16)
            name = hash_to_name.get(h, "0x{:08X}".format(h))
            if name != "0x{:08X}".format(h):
                print("  L{}: store -> {}".format(line_num, name))

        sw = switch_re.search(line)
        if sw:
            h = int(sw.group(1), 16)
            name = hash_to_name.get(h, "0x{:08X}".format(h))
            if name != "0x{:08X}".format(h):
                print("  L{}: == {}".format(line_num, name))

        if "Method_0(" in line:
            print("  L{}: SET".format(line_num))
        if "Method_1(" in line:
            print("  L{}: CHECK".format(line_num))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    blocks, edges = analyze_dispatcher_blocks()
    analyze_func_10AA55()
    analyze_func_24BCE4()
